common.minimum_memory_assumption: 512 MiB available operational allowance; not a measured performance requirement
common.minimum_storage_assumption: 128 MiB free excluding the separately acquired OPA binary
common.resource_interpretation: CPU, memory, and storage are execution sufficiency assumptions only. No performance conclusion is drawn from timing or resource use in protocol v1.0.0.

unavoidable_asymmetry: EHCO emits its native nonce-bound proof receipt; OPA emits its native policy decision result. Harness hashing may bind both outputs but is not attributed as native OPA proof capability.

The EHCO operand is a bounded public proof kernel rather than the proprietary Tier One Runtime. The comparison is therefore limited to the frozen public proposition and does not compare full product/system scope.
